proposals.rationale: This lets a public-door message prove it comes from mike. The verb declares asserts=ssh, so it runs as the pre-turn hook: it receives the decoded payload as its single parameter, extracts msg and sig with jq, and verifies the ssh-ed25519 signature with `ssh-keygen -Y verify -I mike -n mshkn` against a baked allowed_signers entry containing mike's public key. On success its stdout is `mike`, which becomes the rest of the principal name (namespace ssh, i.e. ssh:mike). Mike must sign the exact msg text (e.g. printf '%s' "$msg" | ssh-keygen -Y sign -n mshkn) and send it as {"msg":..., "sig":...}.
proposals.title: ssh_verify pre-turn hook for the public door

verb.description: Pre-turn hook: verify an ssh-ed25519 signature over the payload's msg field and emit the verified principal name mike.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN command -v ssh-keygen >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y openssh-client jq)
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' 'mike ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIMxgpUVbGxL/HlBs2Gk/Kd/qLaYG5PAy9PyYXPKxhCI' > /verb/allowed_signers
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'D=/tmp/v' 'mkdir -p "$D"' 'printf "%s" "$1" | jq -r .msg > "$D/msg"' 'printf "%s" "$1" | jq -r .sig > "$D/msg.sig"' 'ssh-keygen -Y verify -f /verb/allowed_signers -I mike -n mshkn -s "$D/msg.sig" < "$D/msg" >/dev/null 2>&1' 'echo mike' > /verb/run.sh && chmod +x /verb/run.sh

verb.description: Fetch the page at a URL and report its <title>.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' \
'#!/bin/sh' \
'url="$1"' \
'' \
'if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then' \
'  html=$(curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "$url")' \
'elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then' \
'  html=$(wget -qO- -T 30 "$url")' \
'else' \
'  echo "no http client available" >&2' \
'  exit 2' \
'fi' \
'' \
'title=$(printf "%s" "$html" | tr "\n\r" " " | sed -n "s/.*<title[^>]*>\([^<]*\)<\/title>.*/\1/p" | head -n 1 | sed "s/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//")' \
'' \
'if [ -z "$title" ]; then' \
'  echo "no title found" >&2' \
'  exit 1' \
'fi' \
'' \
'printf "%s\n" "$title"' \
> /verb/run.sh && chmod +x /verb/run.sh
